title: Video by santino.inbetween
description:
After 27 years of marriage, starting over means realizing I get to make the decisions now. What my life looks like. Who I become. What I tolerate. Even the little shit.

If you’re rebuilding after divorce or separation too, follow along. I’m figuring this out in real time.

#divorcedafter50 #highfunctioningloneliness #healingjourney
